analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 하락(-3.91%, -5.86%, +31.48% 제외)으로 RSI 21.1→37.5 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 시도. MACD 히스토그램 -3.8265→-0.6757 개선 중. 그러나 5일 고가($171.50)가 20일 고가($215.33) 하회하며 Lower High 패턴 형성. 주봉 RSI 35.3, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 -10.3478로 여전히 약세 구간. ADX 47.9로 추세 강하나 -DI(41.3)가 +DI(17.1) 상회하며 하락 우위. 현재가 $149.30은 볼린저밴드 하단($125.96) 접근 구간. 시장 전체 위험 관리 구간(주식 비중 20% 이하 권고)과 일치. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Consecutive declines over the last 3 trading days (-3.91%, -5.86%, excluding +31.48%) saw RSI rise from 21.1 to 37.5, attempting to exit oversold. MACD histogram is improving from -3.8265 to -0.6757. However, the 5-day high ($171.50) is below the 20-day high ($215.33), forming a Lower High pattern. Weekly RSI is 35.3 and weekly MACD histogram is -10.3478, indicating a continued bearish phase. ADX is strong at 47.9, but -DI (41.3) exceeds +DI (17.1), showing bearish dominance. The current price of $149.30 is approaching the lower Bollinger Band ($125.96). This aligns with the overall market's risk management phase (recommending stock allocation below 20%). Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
